inputs.checklistItemText: Standard AW construction notes missing from plan sheets or substantive content not matching Notes and Templates / current AW General Info Sheet (~90% semantic threshold)
inputs.question: Are there standard Austin Water construction notes on this sheet with a heading like "STANDARD CONSTRUCTION NOTES" or similar? If yes, approximately how many numbered notes are there, and what is the date/version shown (if any)?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a presence check for a specific text element (standard construction notes section with a particular heading style) and then reading label/metadata from it (count of notes, date/version).
